title: monster@4
description: SRD 5.1 monster, v4 = monster@3 carried in full (docs/proposals/VERSION_BUMP_BATCH.md 1.3) on common@2: save_effect actions, on_hit riders, mechanical reactions[], bonus_actions[], resources[], on_event / apply_modifier / grant_action / heal_pool trait effects, innate spellcasting. Migrated @3 files carry per-entry 'inert: true' stamps and inert effects (schema-valid, never authored on disk; the validator rejects an authored 'inert'). Integers only (4.3).

rating.description: String so fractional CRs need no floats.

legendary_actions.description: Descriptive and ignored by the engine (T&C-G11 is deferred); common@1 action list type, never loaded.

presentation.description: Presentation-only; 'ai' not allowed in v2 (use behavior.ai).

traits.description: Traits. Effects are mechanically active; never bake their numbers into actions or other stats.

forward_compat.description: Opt-in flags for engine features that are not implemented yet (elevation, T&C-G12). Descriptive and ignored by sim; listed with the inert mechanics. New enum values widen the @4 schemas additively.

inert_mechanics.description: Mechanics the document carries but the engine must ignore (e.g. 'reactions', 'bonus_actions', 'equipment', 'damage[1..]'). Written by the 3->4 migration; a hand-written @4 file may carry it too.
